headline: Trump threatens Washington will 'have no choice but to leave' Europe
dek: Truth Social post text quoted identically across multiple outlets; rally remarks relayed. PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM (Trump).
sources: Donald Trump via Truth Social + Kansas rally remarks; reported by Wion, Gulf News, arabtimesonline, ET Now
fault_line: Is Trump defending American interests — or torching the Western alliance while fighting a war its allies were never asked to join?

sections.what_happened: Truth Social post text quoted identically across multiple outlets; rally remarks relayed. PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM (Trump). 'Could leave Iran now' contradicted by ongoing carrier ops. Outlets note the warning 'did not constitute a formal announcement of a US withdrawal from Europe or NATO'.
sections.what_verified: Post text consistent verbatim across tvcnews.tv, europesays.com, Wion, Gulf News.
sections.what_disputed: No European capital on record reacting; no NATO/EU official response found. Rhetorical posture threat only — NOT an elevation-level military posture change.
sections.why_matters: Trump admits out loud what the Iran war already proved: allies are accessories, not partners — 'we tested them' on a war Washington started, and now the bill for the alliance comes due.
sections.context: Background: Trump threatens Washington will 'have no choice but to leave' Europe; says US could end Iran campaign 'right now'

totw_analysis: Our read: Trump admits out loud what the Iran war already proved: allies are accessories, not partners — 'we tested them' on a war Washington started, and now the bill for the alliance comes due. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is Trump defending American interests — or torching the Western alliance while fighting a war its allies were never asked to join?
